title: Crew of Wellington LN281
memorial_details: description: Three-sectioned, brick wall with inset rectangular, black, slate tablet, all set within a triangular, gravelled surround.  The dedication is incised in white, upper and lower-case letters.  Three coloured crests (painted or possibly enamelled) - RAF top centre, 14 Squadron OTU lower left and Bomber Command lower right.  An information board is mounted on the obverse of the wall.
